title: Black/Matrix
native_title: ブラック・マトリクス
overview:
Black/Matrix is a simulation RPG set in a world ruled by black-winged demons, where love, kindness and everything else held dear in our world are crimes. You are a white-winged angel serving a black-winged master. When your master openly declares her love for you, she is taken away as a criminal, and you set out to fight your way to her rescue. Choose your master from five women at the start, and spend your first days at a small farmhouse fishing, cooking and doing chores before the story takes you to town.

Battles play out on isometric maps. Pick your starting positions, swap weapons with enemies, set a defensive strategy for the enemy's turn and time your spells to the shifting Biorhythm gauge. Strike down fallen foes to earn Blood Points for special techniques and weapon infusions, share out experience among your party as you see fit, and train in free battle areas between story chapters.

- Five selectable masters
- Single player
- Memory backup save
